# Security Policy

## Supported versions

MapIt is pre-1.x in active development. Security fixes are applied to the latest released version on the `main` branch.

| Version | Supported |
|---|---|
| latest `main` / newest release | Yes |
| older releases | No |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue for security problems.

Instead, report privately through GitHub's built-in flow:

1. Go to the [Security tab](https://github.com/agusumri/MapIt/security) of the repository.
2. Choose **Report a vulnerability** (GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting).

Include, where possible:

- A description of the issue and its impact.
- A minimal reproduction (configuration + mapping call).
- Affected version and target framework.

You can expect an initial response within a few days. Once a fix is ready, it will be released and the report credited unless you prefer to stay anonymous.
